pages.text: Open your inventory to see your backpack above the nine hotbar slots. A backpack slot can hold up to 10,000 of a stackable item if you have enough capacity. Scroll to reach more slots.$(br2)The hotbar and crafting grid use their usual stack sizes.

pages.title: Find Items
pages.text: Click $(thing)Search$() to filter by item name or registry ID. Use $(thing)@ModName$() to filter by mod, for example $(thing)@Biomes Black$(). Middle-click a backpack slot with an empty cursor or click $(thing)Sort$() to combine matching stacks across the whole backpack.

pages.title: Take and Deposit
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Left-click$() a slot to pick up or place a stack.$(li)$(thing)Right-click$() to split a stack or place one item.$(li)$(thing)Drag$() a held stack across slots to distribute it.$(li)$(thing)Press 1–9$() to move items to or from that hotbar slot.
